items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 15 at 10:06PM AKST until November 19 at 1:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 3 to 5 feet above the normal high tide
possible, with highest water level rises expected around
Hooper Bay. Southeast winds could gust as high as 55 mph.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast, primarily Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...From late Tuesday night through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Moderate coastal flooding is possible. Roads may be
closed. Low lying property including homes, businesses, and some

occur.
items.instruction:

closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
